# RPL Peptide Research Tools (llms.txt)
> AI reference for tool.rplpeptides.com — Free online calculators for peptide research.

## Site Information
- Home: https://tool.rplpeptides.com/
- Main Store: https://rplpeptides.com/
- Data & Reference: https://data.rplpeptides.com/
- Product Catalog: https://rplpeptides.com/product-list/

## Available Tools

### 1. Peptide Molecular Weight Calculator ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
- **URL:** https://tool.rplpeptides.com/molecular-weight-calculator/
- **Input:** One-letter amino acid sequence (e.g., YQVAD)
- **Output:** Monoisotopic MW, average MW, molecular formula, net charge at pH 7, extinction coefficient at 280 nm, sequence length, molar absorptivity
- **Modifications:** Acetylation (+42.01 Da), amidation (-0.98 Da), pyroglutamic acid (-17.03 Da), formylation (+28.01 Da), disulfide bridges
- **Keywords:** peptide molecular weight calculator, peptide mass calculator, amino acid sequence calculator
- **Formula:** MW = Σ(AA masses) - (n-1) × 18.01056 + modifications

### 2. Peptide Properties Calculator
- **URL:** https://tool.rplpeptides.com/peptide-property-calculator/
- **Input:** One-letter sequence, pH, N-terminal modification
- **Output:** Sequence length, monoisotopic MW, average MW, isoelectric point (pI), net charge at user pH, GRAVY hydropathicity, instability index, aliphatic index
- **Keywords:** peptide properties calculator, pI calculator, GRAVY index peptide
- **Method:** pI via bisection, charge via Henderson-Hasselbalch

### 3. Peptide Dilution Calculator
- **URL:** https://tool.rplpeptides.com/dilution-calculator/
- **Input:** Peptide mass, desired concentration (mg/mL, mM, µM)
- **Output:** Solvent volume needed
- **Keywords:** peptide dilution calculator, peptide reconstitution calculator
- **Formula:** V = m / C (for mg/mL); V = (m × 1000) / (MW × C) for mM

### 4. Molarity Calculator
- **URL:** https://tool.rplpeptides.com/molarity-calculator/
- **Input:** Mass + MW + volume -> molarity; or target M + MW + volume -> mass
- **Output:** Molarity in mM/µM, nmol, mg/mL
- **Keywords:** peptide molarity calculator, concentration converter
- **Formula:** C(M) = mass(g) / (MW × V(L))

### 5. Peptide Purity Calculator
- **URL:** https://tool.rplpeptides.com/purity-calculator/
- **Input:** Stated purity (%), total amount
- **Output:** Active peptide mass, impurity content, correction factor
- **Keywords:** peptide purity calculator, active peptide mass
- **Formula:** Active = Total × Purity / 100

### 6. Peptide Comparison Tool
- **URL:** https://tool.rplpeptides.com/peptide-comparison/
- **Peptides:** Tirzepatide, Semaglutide, Retatrutide, BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu, Semax, Epitalon, MK-677, Ipamorelin
- **Parameters:** Class, category, sequence length, MW, mechanism, applications, purity
- **Keywords:** peptide comparison, compare peptides

### 7. Storage Stability Calculator
- **URL:** https://tool.rplpeptides.com/storage-calculator/
- **Input:** Form (lyophilized/solution), temperature, peptide type, environment
- **Output:** Expected shelf life, freeze-thaw stability, storage recommendations
- **Keywords:** peptide storage calculator, peptide stability

### 8. Amino Acid Code Converter
- **URL:** https://tool.rplpeptides.com/amino-acid-converter/
- **Input:** One-letter or three-letter amino acid codes
- **Output:** Converted codes
- **Keywords:** amino acid converter, 1-letter to 3-letter converter
- **Data:** All 20 standard amino acids with full reference table

## Integrations
- Data references link to https://data.rplpeptides.com/
- Product links lead to https://rplpeptides.com/
- All tools are free, client-side JavaScript
- No data stored on servers
- Calculations use IUPAC/ExPASy standard constants
